name: hopeanddespair-world
description: A living atlas of human progress, suffering, and uncertainty.

scripts.check:nojs: test -z "$(find dist -name '*.js' -not -path '*/pagefind/*' 2>/dev/null)" && echo 'OK: zero external JS on content pages (search index under /pagefind only)' || (echo 'FAIL: external JS found outside /pagefind' && find dist -name '*.js' -not -path '*/pagefind/*' && exit 1)
scripts.check:nolib: ! grep -rlE 'd3\.(min|v[0-9]|select|scale)|chart\.js|new Chart\(|Highcharts|Plotly|echarts|recharts' dist --include='*.html' --include='*.js' || (echo 'FAIL: a charting library leaked into the build' && exit 1)
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm check:size && pnpm check:nojs && pnpm check:nolib
